title: Who Is Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis, Convicted in Tupac Shakur Murder Trial?
summary: Duane Keith Davis, once a high-ranking member of the South Side Compton Crips, long said he was in a Cadillac with the shooter in 1996. Then he began to recant his accounts.
